subject: access JavaScript variable value in ui.R

messages.author: 66aaf5d139ba9c7f
messages.subject: access JavaScript variable value in ui.R
parts:
I have a selectInput like:

selectInput("tool", "Tools:", choices = c("ToolA","ToolB"))

Say I now define a function like:

controlForToolA <- function() {
  sliderInput('newslider',"New slider for tool A:", min = 1, max = 10, value = 1, step = 1)
}

I would like to use something like the following to get that control into ui.R when ToolA has been selected: 

get(paste('controlFor',input$tool, sep=""))()

Now input$tool won't work in ui.R so I would need to access the value of the JavaScript variable "input.tool". Could someone tell me what is the easiest way to do this?

I have seen some posts on related topics can not yet figure out how to make this work. Is this something tag$... can do? If so, how?

I know I can do something like this with conditionalPanel(condition = "input.tool == ToolA") but once you have a lot of tools that need different controls ui.R starts to get very messy. Hence the idea above.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: access JavaScript variable value in ui.R
parts: Can you give a little more context? I know you've used reactiveUI so you're not talking about simply getting newslider to appear in the page. So I'm assuming you've already got it in the page, and now you want to access its value from JavaScript. Can you tell us why? There are undocumented ways to get at these values but they will never be called back, so it matters when and how you are using this data.

messages.author: 66aaf5d139ba9c7f
messages.subject: Re: access JavaScript variable value in ui.R
parts:
I have a list of about 15 analysis-tools I plan to include in my app (e.g., compare means, regression, conjoint, etc.). Some of the tools need similar ui-controls but many vary as well. My ui.R is getting a bit difficult to manage with all the conditionalPanels and I have only implemented hand-full of tools so far so it likely to get worse before I am finished.

Also, I would like to make the app as modular as possible. That way, if someone wants to add a tool, they would (preferably) just need to create one R-file with ui and analysis elements in it (something like the below). Then I could use a get() statement in ui.R to get the relevant control elements depending on the tool selected by the user. In my example it would be someting like:
get(paste('controlFor',input$tool, sep=""))()

where intput$tool would be 'SingleMean' selected from a selectInput('tool' ....). Except of course that input$tool won't work in ui.R. So if I could access a the value of the selectInput('too' ...) this should work.

controlsForSingleMean <- function() {
uiOutput("var1"),
uiOutput("alternative"),
sliderInput('sigLevel',"Significance level:", min = 0.85, max = 0.99, value = 0.95, step = 0.01),
numericInput("compValue", "Comparison value:", 0)
}

summary.singleMean <- function(result) {
result
}

plot.singleMean <- function(result) {

dat <- getdata()
x <- dat[,input$var1]
ifelse(is.factor(x), bw <- .1, bw <- diff(range(x)) / 12)

p <- ggplot(dat, aes_string(x=input$var1)) + 
geom_histogram(colour = 'black', fill = 'blue', binwidth = bw, alpha = .1) + 
geom_vline(xintercept = input$compValue, color = 'red', linetype = 'longdash', size = 1) +
geom_vline(xintercept = mean(x), color = 'black', linetype = 'solid', size = 1) +
geom_vline(xintercept = result$conf.int, color = 'black', linetype = 'longdash', size = .5)
print(p)
}

extra.singleMean <- function(result) {
cat("Under development\n")
}

singleMean <- reactive(function() {
if(is.null(input$var1)) return("Please select a variable")
dat <- getdata()[,input$var1]
t.test(dat, mu = input$compValue, alternative = input$alternative, conf.level = input$sigLevel)
})

parts:
Well ... basically ... because I had no idea that was possible :) This is great! Works like a charm. 

Here is what I now have:

In server.R I have a bunch of functions 'ui_tool' where tools are various analysis techniques:

ui_kmeansClustering <- function() {
  wellPanel(
    numericInput("km_seed", "Set random seed:", 1234, min = 0),
    selectInput(inputId = "km_nrClus", label = "Number of clusters", choices = 2:20, selected = NULL)
}

Also in server.R i have the following reactiveUI that call the appropriate ui_... function depending on which analysis the user selects.

# the 'grand' ui-element caller
output$analysis_ui_controls <- reactiveUI(function() {
  get(paste('ui_',input$tool, sep=""))()
})

Finally, in ui.R i have:

uiOutput("analysis_ui_controls")

To bring in the ui-elements for the selected analysis tools.

Thanks Joe!!!!
